inputs.text: Organisers of the “No Kings” protests said an estimated 8 million people attended more than 3,300 events across all 50 US states, voicing opposition to President Donald Trump’s leadership. AFP reported the events were held nationwide, but US authorities have not provided an official count. Organisers said turnout exceeded the previous demonstrations in October, with “about one million more participants and 600 more events.”
